seoTitle: How to Set Up Stripe Email Receipts (2026 Guide)
metaDescription: Turn on automatic Stripe email receipts for payments, refunds, and subscription renewals, and customize them with your branding in a few minutes.
intro: Automatic receipts save you from manually confirming every payment and make your business look more professional. This guide covers where email receipt settings live in the Stripe dashboard, how to turn them on for payments, refunds, and renewals, and how to add your own branding so the emails feel like they came from you rather than a generic processor.

steps.heading: Find email receipt settings in the dashboard
steps.body: Email receipt controls sit in your Stripe dashboard's settings area, separate from your payment flow itself, so it's worth locating them before you go live.

steps.heading: Enable automatic receipts for payments
steps.body: Turn on the toggle for successful payments so customers automatically get a receipt the moment a charge succeeds, with no manual step from you.

steps.heading: Set up receipts for refunds and renewals
steps.body: Beyond one-time payments, Stripe can also send receipts for refunds and subscription renewals, which is important if you run recurring billing.

steps.heading: Customize the receipt with your branding
steps.body: Add your logo and business details to the receipt template so the email matches your brand instead of looking like a generic Stripe notice.

faq.question: Do Stripe email receipts cost extra?
faq.answer: No, sending automatic email receipts is a built-in Stripe dashboard feature and doesn't require a paid add-on.

faq.question: Will customers get a receipt for subscription renewals automatically?
faq.answer: Yes, once you enable the setting for renewals, Stripe sends a receipt each time a subscription payment goes through, not just on the first charge.

faq.question: Can I customize what the receipt email looks like?
faq.answer: Yes, you can add your branding, such as your logo and business name, so the receipt looks consistent with the rest of your customer communication.

faq.question: What happens if a payment is refunded?
faq.answer: If you enable refund receipts, Stripe will automatically email the customer confirming the refund once it's processed.
